_authoring.purpose: AI context for milking events and reactions to completed milking.
_authoring.player_controls: How the method, relief and recorded outcome are described.
_authoring.contains: Start/end event descriptions, method-specific completion text and response instructions.
_authoring.perspective: The milked character owns the experience; completion narration reacts to her recorded session.
_authoring.boundary: Does not start milking or decide how much milk was removed or retained.

_help: Edit template text or replace a template with a string array. Keep the documented placeholders. Use MCM Reload Narration JSON after saving.
